style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Eucalyptus Lambs Ear & Berry Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Enhance your home with the natural charm of this artificial 152cm eucalyptus, lamb’s ear & berry garland. Expertly crafted with soft, silvery lamb’s ear leaves, lush eucalyptus foliage, and delicate berry accents, it creates a beautifully textured display. Perfect for draping across mantels, staircases, or tables, this garland adds a subtle, elegant touch to your décor. Its neutral tones and realistic detailing make it ideal for both seasonal styling and everyday displays, effortlessly blending with a variety of interior themes. Lightweight yet full of character, it’s easy to shape and arrange to suit your space. Bring a calming aesthetic to your home with this 152cm eucalyptus, lamb’s ear, and berry garland—a versatile and stylish addition to any interior. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: L152cm.  Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
